title: A root's placeholder names reach no production path: redact and the tracked-file leak scan never pass a root
goal: redact.py takes --root DIR and applies that root's placeholders in its rules and in --scan; check.py's log-row scan passes the log's root to leak_hits, so a root's listed placeholder names pass in that root's log rows only while every leak shape stays the same for every root

import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
def run(*args, text):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/redact.py', *args], input=text, capture_output=True, text=True)
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(T + '/_root.md', 'w').write('---\nroot: plain\nid_prefix: PN\nvisibility: internal\ndescription: a root with no placeholders\n---\n\n# plain\n')
own = '_tools/fixtures/placeholders/ok'
home = 'C:' + chr(92) + 'Users' + chr(92) + 'anna.nowak' + chr(92) + 'x'
logon = 'logon CORP' + chr(92) + 'anna.nowak'
r = run('--root', own, text=logon)
assert r.returncode == 0 and 'anna.nowak' in r.stdout, ("redact.py --root DIR does not keep the root's own user", r.returncode, r.stdout[-100:], r.stderr[-200:])
s = run('--scan', '--root', own, text=home)
assert s.returncode == 0 and not s.stdout.strip(), ("redact.py --scan --root DIR flags the root's own user", s.returncode, s.stdout[-100:], s.stderr[-200:])
n = run('--scan', '--root', T, text=home)
assert n.returncode == 1 and n.stdout.strip(), ("another root's --scan accepts a name its _root.md does not list", n.returncode, n.stderr[-200:])
w = run('--scan', text=home)
assert w.returncode == 1 and w.stdout.strip(), ('--scan with no --root accepts a root-listed name', w.returncode)
assert 'anna.nowak' not in run(text=logon).stdout, 'redact with no --root keeps a root-listed name'
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)

import os, shutil, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbcommon, check
home = 'C:' + chr(92) + 'Users' + chr(92) + 'anna.nowak' + chr(92) + 'x'
def log_errors(placeholders):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    open(d + '/_root.md', 'w').write('---\nroot: plx\nid_prefix: PX\nvisibility: internal\n' + ('placeholders: anna.nowak\n' if placeholders else '') + 'description: fixture\n---\n\n# plx\n')
    open(d + '/_logs.csv', 'w', newline='').write(','.join(check.LOG_COLS) + '\nL-aaaaaaaa,"seen 3 times at ' + home + '",20260101T000000Z-0123abcd,2026-01-01,2026-01-02,domain:x,proposed,,\n')
    root = kbcommon.load_root(d)
    del check.errors[:]
    check.check_logs(root, 'plx', {})
    out = list(check.errors)
    shutil.rmtree(d)
    return out
own, plain = log_errors(True), log_errors(False)
print(own); print(plain)
hit = lambda errs: [e for e in errs if 'leak-scan hit (home)' in e]
assert hit(plain), ('the same log row in a root with no placeholders is not flagged', plain)
assert not hit(own), ('a root lists the user as a placeholder and its log row is still flagged', own)
